runIf.description: Sha of the run-if commit; omit when no skip was scoping.

debug.description: Sha of the DEBUG un-skip commit; omit when no skip was flakiness.

feedback.description: Problems with the tools or inputs you used, one entry per problem.

disagreement.description: Only when resumed with a message from the user that you didn't follow: why.

removal.description: Sha of the commit removing the skip-ifs whose tests passed on try, once the factory asks for it.

tryRequest.description: A try push you need (configs no push ran yet): what it should run and why. The factory plans it, the user approves it, and you're resumed with the results.

keepSkips.description: Skips your removal commit drops whose tests still failed on try and that no fix patch fixes: the user decides whether they come back.

failure.description: The failure on try that shows it, with the push.
